notes.body: A full-back dragon with clouds is a classic large tattoo design; a hannya is the horned demon-woman mask from No theatre, another traditional tattoo subject. The story shows one finished and one left as outline only.
notes.span: a fine dragon striking a pose across his whole back, with terrible wheeling clouds spreading their wings to the tips of both arms

notes.body: Only the outline of the demon-mask is inked, about eight-tenths drawn, on bare skin. The text gives no reason for stopping.
notes.span: only the outline of a hannya mask traced, about eight-tenths finished, on the bare skin

notes.body: The guess is that the half-built extension was meant as a room holding the household Buddhist altar. Left unfinished for years, it has no electric light wired in.
notes.span: been meant perhaps for a Buddhist altar room

notes.body: These were current popular tunes in late-1920s Japan, picked up from records, films and schoolboys and practised at home on the harmonica. The trailing (?) is in the Japanese.
notes.span: such things as "Ai Ai Ai" and "Valencia" and "Light Cavalry."

notes.body: Nancy Lee was an English-language sentimental song known in Japan as a sailors' song. Taki's father claims he learned it from sailors while shipping on an American whaler in his schooldays.
notes.span: making the 'boat-song' Nancy Lee his refrain

notes.body: Around four hundred yen is presented as a startlingly high sum, against the wife's ten yen in hand in the restaurant scene. The amount is what turns the nuisance carp into treasure.
Putting things on the month-end bill means leaving shop and restaurant charges to be settled together at the end of the month. It was an ordinary way of running household accounts on credit.
notes.span: Put everything on the month-end bill

notes.body: A cast net is a round weighted net thrown by hand over the water to fall over fish. A hand pump later borrowed from another villa is a portable pump worked by hand to drain the pond.
notes.span: Shall we try a first throw with the cast net?

data.say: Notes kept sparse to song titles, tattoos, altar-room, money scale, month-end billing and fishing gear, leaving deliberate gaps untouched.
